aaa_enabled.title: Enable AAA Authentication
aaa_enabled.description: AAA must be enabled so that authentication, authorization and accounting for device access are centrally defined rather than falling back to line-local passwords.

secure_vty_transport.title: Restrict VTY transport to secure protocols only
secure_vty_transport.description: VTY lines must accept SSH only. Telnet and other legacy cleartext transports must be disabled.

vty_idle_timeout.title: Set VTY session idle timeout
vty_idle_timeout.description: Idle VTY sessions must be torn down automatically within 10 minutes (600 seconds) or less.

enable_secret_encrypted.title: Store privileged credential as hash and encrypt passwords
enable_secret_encrypted.description: The privileged credential must be stored as a one-way hash, and stored passwords elsewhere in the configuration must not be left in plaintext.

no_default_snmp_community.title: Unset default SNMP community names
no_default_snmp_community.description: No SNMP community string may use a well-known default value such as 'public' or 'private'.

http_server_disabled.title: Disable HTTP management server
http_server_disabled.description: The on-box unencrypted HTTP management server must be disabled.

ssh_version_2.title: Enforce SSH protocol version 2
ssh_version_2.description: The device must enforce SSH protocol version 2 for secure administrative management.

logging_enabled.title: Configure a logging destination
logging_enabled.description: Logging must be enabled and must have at least one destination: a remote syslog host, a sized local buffer, or both.

management_acl.title: Restrict management access by source IP
management_acl.description: An ACL/filter must be applied to restrict administrative access to authorized source subnets.

login_banner.title: Configure a login banner
login_banner.description: A banner must be displayed before or at login to warn unauthorized users.

password_min_length.title: Enforce minimum password length
password_min_length.description: The device must refuse locally configured passwords shorter than eight characters.

ntp_configured.title: Configure at least one NTP server
ntp_configured.description: The device must synchronise its clock with at least one NTP time source.

no_write_snmp_community.title: Do not configure read-write SNMP communities
no_write_snmp_community.description: No SNMP v1/v2c community may grant read-write access.
